info.title: UCP Shopping Service
info.description:
Canonical MCP/JSON-RPC interface for UCP Shopping service. Schema references are logical pointers - actual payload shape is determined by negotiated capabilities.

**Endpoint Resolution:** This spec defines methods only. The endpoint URL MUST be obtained from the merchant's discovery profile at `/.well-known/ucp` under `services["dev.ucp.shopping"][transport=mcp].endpoint`. The server entry below is a placeholder for tooling compatibility.

servers.name: merchant
servers.description: Merchant-provided endpoint from UCP discovery profile

ucp-agent.description: Platform agent identification. Maps to HTTP UCP-Agent header.

profile.description: URL to the platform's UCP profile document.

idempotency-key.description: Unique key for retry safety. Maps to HTTP Idempotency-Key header.

params.name: meta
params.description: UCP request metadata containing Platform identification and any operation-specific idempotency key.

params.name: checkout
params.description: Checkout input used to create the session.

result.name: checkout
result.description: The created Checkout, or a UCP business outcome when no valid Checkout can be created.

methods.name: get_checkout
methods.description: Get the latest state of a checkout session.

params.name: meta
params.description: UCP request metadata containing Platform identification.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the checkout session.

result.name: checkout
result.description: The current Checkout, or a UCP business outcome when no valid Checkout can be returned.

methods.name: update_checkout
methods.description: Update Checkout is a full replacement operation. A new Update Checkout operation is not permitted while Checkout status is `complete_in_progress`. Duplicate requests remain subject to Replay Protection. If the Business receives a new Update Checkout request in that state, it leaves the Checkout unchanged and returns the current Checkout with a recoverable error Message.

params.name: checkout
params.description: Replacement Checkout state for the session.

result.name: checkout
result.description: The authoritative Checkout after the update attempt, including any business outcome messages.

methods.name: search_catalog
methods.summary: Search for products in the catalog
methods.description: Search for products using query text, filters, and pagination.

params.name: meta
params.description: UCP request metadata containing Platform identification.

params.name: catalog
params.description: Catalog search query, filters, and pagination input.

result.name: response
result.description: Catalog search results and pagination state.

methods.name: lookup_catalog
methods.summary: Batch lookup products or variants by identifier
methods.description: Batch lookup of products or variants by identifier. See Catalog Lookup capability for supported identifier types and resolution behavior.

params.name: meta
params.description: UCP request metadata containing Platform identification.

params.name: catalog
params.description: Catalog identifiers and lookup input.

result.name: response

methods.name: get_order

result.name: order
result.description: The current Order, or a UCP business outcome when no valid Order can be returned.

methods.name: get_product
methods.description: Retrieve complete product detail by identifier with optional interactive option selection.

params.name: meta
params.description: UCP request metadata containing Platform identification.
